authority.playerControl: current selected profile must control every consulted Trainer or roster-linked Pokémon sheet
authority.sharedInventory: GM-only until an explicit delegated equipment policy exists

atomicity.boundary: source inventory, destination inventory, every owning sheet, equipment state, immutable operation evidence, and realtime event rows

idempotency.sameCommand: exact stored result with exactReplay=true and no writes or publication
idempotency.acceptedEvidence: immutable before and after resource documents plus exact source row

custody.equippedInstanceId: deterministic from operation, canonical item, and exact inventory source identity
custody.inventorySource: stable row identity plus exact expected container revision
custody.equippedSource: owner, sheet revision, equipment revision, instance identity, and instance revision
custody.returnIdentity: reuse exact free provenance row or allocate one deterministic return row
custody.stackRemainder: never merged implicitly; displaced or taken whole items receive a distinct stable row
custody.serializedItemPolicy: P8-045 preserves the stable equipped-item identity, revision, configuration, and bounded item-specific state on every return and re-equip

privacyAndRealtime.playerHttp: raw equipment provenance and private configuration remain redacted
privacyAndRealtime.realtime: persisted sheet and group-inventory updates are appended in the operation transaction and published only after commit

failurePolicy.incompatible: return the exact reviewed safe reason and move nothing
